question: Should maintainers keep this PR as the canonical branch and ask for a rebase/repair, or replace it with a narrower current-main PR now that main already has partial large-attachment fixes?
rationale: The PR is useful and well-proven, but it is conflicting with current main, overlaps merged PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99213 and e850750754f2, and changes config/session-state behavior that should not be resolved by cleanup automation alone.

options.title: Rebase and repair this PR
options.body: Ask the contributor or a maintainer to rebase onto current ui/src/pages/chat paths, fix the UI base64 accumulation issue, and rerun focused proof before merge.

options.title: Split a narrower replacement
options.body: Create a current-main replacement that carries only the remaining data-URL stripping, stale queue cleanup, and approved pdfMaxBytesMb semantics, then close this branch after the replacement exists.

options.title: Pause for policy only
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers decide whether pdfMaxBytesMb should affect inbound extraction at all, leaving only https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90098 open as the tracker.

recommendation.title: Rebase and repair this PR
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor or a maintainer to rebase onto current ui/src/pages/chat paths, fix the UI base64 accumulation issue, and rerun focused proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the most recent current-main owner of the moved gateway/Control UI chat paths and can route the rebase versus replacement choice.
